title: Gaussian VCMoE Tutorial
text: vcmoe_confband() computes diagnostic-gated analytic-style Epanechnikov path bands. returned object contains interval table grid-level diagnostics. Rows status != "ok" blocked local fit weak interval interpreted. coefficient-function plots, use local-linear intercept rows. slope rows describe local derivative terms coefficient functions .
code: band <- vcmoe_confband(   fit,   data = sim$data,   level = 0.95,   type = "simultaneous",   coefficient_set = "expert",   strict = FALSE )  band #> VCMoE analytic-style confidence bands #>   family: gaussian #>   components: 2 #>   engine: local_grid_em #>   type: simultaneous #>   level: 0.95 #>   coverage theory: local_likelihood_asymptotic_with_bias_and_boundary_caveats #>   interval rows ok: 32/32 head(band$intervals[, c(   "u", "component", "term", "block", "estimate",   "lower", "upper", "status", "block_reason" )]) #>      u  component        term     block    estimate      lower       upper #> 1 0.15 component1 (Intercept) intercept -0.32044265 -0.5560750 -0.08481032 #> 2 0.15 component1          z1 intercept  0.88704111  0.6068012  1.16728101 #> 3 0.15 component2 (Intercept) intercept  1.12912917  0.8819065  1.37635179 #> 4 0.15 component2          z1 intercept -0.21685213 -0.4883527  0.05464840 #> 5 0.15 component1 (Intercept)     slope  0.94748432  0.3255871  1.56938155 #> 6 0.15 component1          z1     slope  0.07598394 -0.5013185  0.65328636 #>   status block_reason #> 1     ok         <NA> #> 2     ok         <NA> #> 3     ok         <NA> #> 4     ok         <NA> #> 5     ok         <NA> #> 6     ok         <NA> scb_plot <- subset(   band$intervals,   coefficient_set == "expert" & block == "intercept" & status == "ok" )  ggplot(scb_plot, aes(x = u, y = estimate, color = component, fill = component)) +   geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), alpha = 0.18, color = NA) +   geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +   facet_wrap(~ term, scales = "free_y") +   labs(     x = "u",     y = "coefficient",     color = "component",     fill = "component"   ) +   theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

title: Joint-Path EM
text: Joint-path diagnostics include selected start, outer iteration trace, number observations assigned grid point. trace’s objective column sample-level nearest-grid log-likelihood. diagnostic, monotonicity guarantee: label-consistent M-step nearest-grid responsibility update can decrease . Convergence therefore based posterior parameter deltas.
code: library(VCMoE) sim <- simulate_vcmoe_gaussian(   n = 90,   k = 2,   seed = 21,   separation = 1.7,   scenario = "well_separated" )  fit <- vcmoe_fit(   y ~ z1 | x1,   data = sim$data,   u = "u",   k = 2,   family = "gaussian",   bandwidth = 0.40,   u_grid = c(0.25, 0.50, 0.75),   engine = "joint_path_em",   control = list(     maxit = 12,     n_starts = 1,     seed = 22,     warn_ambiguous = FALSE   ) )  fit$engine_id #> [1] "joint_path_em" head(predict(fit, type = "posterior")) #>              [,1]         [,2] #> [1,] 1.849120e-02 9.815088e-01 #> [2,] 9.931178e-01 6.882247e-03 #> [3,] 2.740944e-01 7.259056e-01 #> [4,] 9.979856e-01 2.014450e-03 #> [5,] 3.426019e-09 1.000000e+00 #> [6,] 1.000000e+00 1.809757e-16 fit$diagnostics$joint_path_converged #> [1] FALSE fit$diagnostics$joint_path_assignment #>   grid_id    u u_original n_assigned #> 1       1 0.25  0.2562670         26 #> 2       2 0.50  0.5011344         20 #> 3       3 0.75  0.7460017         44 tail(fit$diagnostics$joint_path_trace) #>    iteration objective objective_delta posterior_delta parameter_delta #> 7          7 -98.90620       0.6030760      0.12659834      0.12075461 #> 8          8 -98.49352       0.4126819      0.15574634      0.08947613 #> 9          9 -98.22225       0.2712709      0.14582814      0.06661256 #> 10        10 -97.99489       0.2273618      0.11564046      0.06812650 #> 11        11 -97.78657       0.2083137      0.07866552      0.07119413 #> 12        12 -97.61032       0.1762492      0.04935146      0.06572002 #>    converged #> 7      FALSE #> 8      FALSE #> 9      FALSE #> 10     FALSE #> 11     FALSE #> 12     FALSE

title: Joint-Path EM
text: Runtime grows approximately number observations, grid points, EM iterations, starts. default, joint-path EM rejects 100 grid points grid--observation ratio 0.2. Set control$allow_dense_u_grid = TRUE explicitly accepting cost. grid close unique(u) also produces warning approaches one local model per observation. start converges control$maxit, fit returned explicit warning finite interim estimates can still inspected. Treat estimates provisional review joint_path_trace inference.

title: Joint-Path EM
text: Analytic confidence bands use observed local-likelihood sandwich plug-evaluated fitted coefficient arrays. joint-path fits local-curvature approximation, covariance complete finite-grid shared-path estimator. returned metadata states shared-path, label-selection, finite-grid cross-grid responsibility uncertainty included reports score imbalance. Parametric bootstrap refits, GLRT full null fits, reduced fits, bandwidth-selection refits preserve selected engine. joint-path GLRT, constant-coefficient null uses paper-inspired update: constrained local paths replaced every M-step mean weighted nearest-grid observation-assignment counts. projected estimator, generic constrained MLE. statistic evaluates every observation nearest grid point, grid approximation sample-point criterion. Failed nonconverged null fits blocked. GLRT calibration defaults "none"; request analytic calibration documented approximation, use engine-preserving parametric bootstrap calibration. Always inspect convergence, component sizes, label ambiguity, null-fit diagnostics interpreting inference either engine.
code: band <- vcmoe_confband(fit, strict = FALSE)  boot <- vcmoe_bootstrap(   fit,   data = sim$data,   B = 200,   seed = 23 )  test <- vcmoe_glrt(   fit,   data = sim$data,   test = "coefficient",   coefficient_set = "expert",   component = 1,   term = "z1",   calibration = "none" )  selection <- vcmoe_select_bandwidth(   y ~ z1 | x1,   data = sim$data,   u = "u",   family = "gaussian",   bandwidth_grid = c(0.30, 0.40, 0.50),   folds = 3,   u_grid = c(0.25, 0.50, 0.75),   engine = "joint_path_em" )

title: VCMoE
text: VCMoE represents observation coming one k latent components. component (c), expert model describes response distribution, gating model describes probability belonging component. continuous coordinate u, gating model form: expert mean modeled family-specific component functions. Gaussian response, expert model form: current implementation uses Epanechnikov kernel local fitting scaled local-linear basis. public interface supports k = 2:10 diagnostic outputs convergence, label alignment, component overlap, inference quality.
code: Pr(C_i = c | X_i, U_i = u) = softmax_c( X_i gamma_c(u) ) E(Y_i | C_i = c, Z_i, U_i = u) = Z_i alpha_c(u)
